title: NMR Spectral Data
description: Dataset subject: NMR spectral data and associated configuration files. Generated by: Automated NMR experiment execution using Bruker TOPSPIN software. Activity target: 1H NMR spectra acquisition and processing. Instruments: Bruker NMR spectrometer (model unspecified). Setting plan: Defined by parameter files (acqu, pulseprogram, format.temp) specifying acquisition sequence, pulse parameters, and frequency settings. Data processing involved TopSpin software for Fourier transformation and baseline correction. Characteristics: Data format includes proprietary binary (fid) and text-based parameter files. Audit trail (audita.txt) records user actions and system configuration. Data files (pdata) contain processed spectral data and intermediate results. File summaries: r1|10/acqu|summary=NMR acquisition parameters. r2|10/pdata/1/proc|fmt=text|summary=NMR processing parameters. r3|10/pdata/1/procs|fmt=text|summary=NMR processing parameters. r4|10/audita.txt|fmt=txt|summary=TOPSPIN audit trail. r5|10/pdata/1/outd|fmt=text|summary=NMR configuration settings. r6|10/format.temp|fmt=text|summary=NMR acquisition parameters. r7|10/pulseprogram|fmt=text|summary=NMR pulse program. r8|10/acqus|summary=NMR acquisition parameters. r9|10/fid|fmt=binary|summary=Raw NMR data. r10|10/fq1list|summary=Signal intensity values.
